title: Lung epithelial transcriptional responses to bleomycin and effects of IRE1α or TGFβ inhibition
overall_design: Factorial design. Principal treatment groups are: Saline/Control (6 mice), Bleomycin/Control (9 mice), Bleomycin/KIRA8 (5 mice) and Bleomycin/3G9 (4 mice). Each mouse has a corresponding whole lung and epithelial library.
